findings.description:
LaunchEscrow.withdrawCreditFor(address) (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#134-142) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = recipient.call{value: amount}() (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#139)

LaunchToken.withdrawTaxFor(address) (src/LaunchToken.sol#176-184) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = recipient.call{value: due}() (src/LaunchToken.sol#181)

Reentrancy in TokenLaunch.finalizePool() (src/TokenLaunch.sol#131-172):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- lp = p.mint(LP_DESTINATION) (src/TokenLaunch.sol#157)
	Balance read before the call:
	- lpBefore = p.balanceOf(LP_DESTINATION) (src/TokenLaunch.sol#156)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- lp == 0 || p.balanceOf(LP_DESTINATION) < lpBefore + lp (src/TokenLaunch.sol#158)
		- stale variable `lpBefore`

Reentrancy in TokenLaunch.finalizePool() (src/TokenLaunch.sol#131-172):
	External calls:
	- IWBNB(wbnb).deposit{value: bnb}() (src/TokenLaunch.sol#154)
	- lp = p.mint(LP_DESTINATION) (src/TokenLaunch.sol#157)
	- token.burnSaleInventory(burn) (src/TokenLaunch.sol#164)
	External calls sending eth:
	- IWBNB(wbnb).deposit{value: bnb}() (src/TokenLaunch.sol#154)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- poolCreated = true (src/TokenLaunch.sol#166)
	TokenLaunch.poolCreated (src/TokenLaunch.sol#21) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- TokenLaunch.poolCreated (src/TokenLaunch.sol#21)
	- TokenLaunch.refundEligible() (src/TokenLaunch.sol#83-89)

LaunchToken._cumulative() (src/LaunchToken.sol#95-107) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- value += priceX112 * elapsed (src/LaunchToken.sol#105)
	- priceX112 = (uint256(r0) << 112) / r1 (src/LaunchToken.sol#104)

LaunchToken.conversionQuote(uint256) (src/LaunchToken.sol#130-153) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- ! launched || averagePriceX112 == 0 || averageUpdatedAt == 0 || block.timestamp - averageUpdatedAt > oracleMaxAge (src/LaunchToken.sol#131-132)

LaunchToken.conversionQuote(uint256) (src/LaunchToken.sol#130-153) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- minimumBnb == 0 (src/LaunchToken.sol#147)

LaunchEscrow.closeTime() (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#87-89) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- soldOutAt == 0 (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#88)

LaunchEscrow.totalPause() (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#79-81) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- pausedAt == 0 (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#80)

Reentrancy in NftLaunch.claimFor(address,uint256[]) (src/NftLaunch.sol#75-84):
	External calls:
	- _safeMint(wallet,id) (src/NftLaunch.sol#81)
		- retval = IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(operator,from,tokenId,data) (@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/utils/ERC721Utils.sol#33-47)
		- ERC721Utils.checkOnERC721Received(_msgSender(),address(0),to,tokenId,data) (@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol#289)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- ++ deliveredCount (src/NftLaunch.sol#80)
	NftLaunch.deliveredCount (src/NftLaunch.sol#14) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- NftLaunch.deliveredCount (src/NftLaunch.sol#14)

	- _credit(platformRecipient,activePrincipal - bnb - creator,TOKEN_PLATFORM) (src/TokenLaunch.sol#170)

NftLaunch.finalize() (src/NftLaunch.sol#54-63) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- settled || (! successEligible() && ! refundEligible()) (src/NftLaunch.sol#55)

LaunchEscrow.constructor(LaunchEscrow.BaseConfig) (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#62-77) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- c.identity.code.length == 0 || c.platformAdmin == address(0) || c.platformRecipient == address(0) || c.creatorRecipient == address(0) || c.startsAt <= block.timestamp || c.startsAt > type()(uint64).max - DURATION || c.unitPrice == 0 || c.capacity == 0 || c.configHash == bytes32(0) || c.capacity > type()(uint256).max / c.unitPrice (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#63-67)

LaunchToken.conversionQuote(uint256) (src/LaunchToken.sol#130-153) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- ! launched || averagePriceX112 == 0 || averageUpdatedAt == 0 || block.timestamp - averageUpdatedAt > oracleMaxAge (src/LaunchToken.sol#131-132)
	- minimumBnb == 0 (src/LaunchToken.sol#147)
	- quoted.length != 2 || quoted[1] < minimumBnb || quoted[1] > Math.mulDiv(referenceQuote,10_000 + MAX_SHORTFALL_BPS,10_000) (src/LaunchToken.sol#151-152)

TokenLaunch.earlyExitOpen() (src/TokenLaunch.sol#91-95) uses timestamp for comparisons

	- ! settled && ! refundEligible() && soldOutAt == 0 && block.timestamp >= startsAt && block.timestamp < endsAt - EXIT_CUTOFF (src/TokenLaunch.sol#93-94)

NftLaunch.refundFor(address) (src/NftLaunch.sol#65-72) uses timestamp for comparisons

	- pausedAt != 0 || accumulatedPause >= MAX_PAUSE (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#101)
	- pausedAt == 0 (src/LaunchEscrow.sol#104)
